rundown: Bulls beat Zips 17-9 at InfoCision Stadium in Akron, OH. Bulls led 7-6 at the half and never looked back. The 4th quarter decided it: Bulls won it 7-0.
Scoring: Bulls 2 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Zips 1 touchdown and 1 field goal. The last score: M. Burch run for 43 yds, for a TD (O. Hautanen KICK) (4th quarter, 9:58).

Leading the way — Bulls: Jason Wright 8/18, 88 yds, 1 TD; Messiah Burch 24 car, 130 yds, 1 TD; Chance Morrow 4 rec, 36 yds. Zips: Cibastian Broughton 11/24, 192 yds, 1 TD; Jordan Gant 20 car, 72 yds; Kyan Mason 4 rec, 95 yds.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Bulls closed as 7.5-point favorites and covered by 0.5; the total closed at 50.5 and they combined for 26, under by 24.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 11:56 AM ET. It had Bulls 61% and Zips 39%, projecting Bulls 26.3 – Zips 22.1 (48.5 total, Bulls by 4.2).

Final: Bulls 17 – Zips 9. Right winner: it had Bulls at 61%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Bulls came in with a 16% below average attack and a 17% leakier than average defense (8-3, 25.7 scored and 23.8 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 186 and 180 games of evidence. Projected to score 26.3, they scored 17 (−9.3 points, 35% under); projected to allow 22.1, they allowed 9 (−13.1 points, 59% under).

Zips came in with a 24% below average attack and a 40% leakier than average defense (2-9, 20 scored and 33.2 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 35 and 181 games of evidence. Projected to score 22.1, they scored 9 (−13.1 points, 59% under); projected to allow 26.3, they allowed 17 (−9.3 points, 35% under).

The bigger miss was Zips' scoring (-13.1 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 26 against 48.5 projected (-22.5), about the 7th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Bulls by 8 against Bulls by 4.2 projected, about the 40th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Weather (37°F · ? mph wind): Zips ×0.93, Bulls ×0.93. Market (Line movement signal): Zips ×1.02, Bulls ×1.00. It favored Zips, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
AKR ML (+245) at +245: the algo gave it 29% vs 28% fair (+0.9 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 28%). BUFF ML (-305) at -305: the algo gave it 71% vs 72% fair (-0.9 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 72%). AKR +7.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 52% vs 51% fair (+0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. BUFF -7.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 48% vs 49% fair (-0.6 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. OVER 50.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.4 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 50.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.4 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 70% of bets on Bulls, 57% of the money — Bulls covered; total: 71% of bets on the over, 79% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 94% of bets on Bulls, 97% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Zips, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.509 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -4.4 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 204 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.6 points. Team corrections so far: Bulls attack ×1.026, defense ×0.960 (3 games); Zips attack ×0.960, defense ×1.020 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
